behavior: An intelligent, opportunistic omnivore and scavenger that often forages on the ground, caches food, and is usually seen alone, in pairs, or in small groups; larger gatherings occur chiefly at communal roosts.
field_marks: Robust crow shape with a rounded head and strong neck
Ash-gray mantle, breast, belly, and flanks
Glossy black head and throat forming a distinct hood and bib
Black wings contrasting sharply with the gray body
Stout black bill, dark brown eyes, and black legs
habitat: Varied open and semiopen country, including farmland, grassland, moorland, open woodland, coasts, parks, and built environments.
